items.difficulty_reason: 31 行（含 11 行陈述）、sheafy trace 是 RSheafHom 上的同构：对任意 M 检验 + 五等式串（f^{-1} 伴随、tensor internal-Hom 伴随、Rf^! 构造、Rf_! 投影公式（作者标注 important step）、internal-Hom 伴随）每步具名锚定。无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-iso-on-RSheafHom (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 4146-4156

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: test against arbitrary M and expand Hom_Y(M, -) through a string of five equalities: adjunction of f^{-1}, the tensor internal-Hom adjunction on X, the construction of Rf^!, the projection formula for Rf_!, and the tensor internal-Hom adjunction on Y; every step is anchored in a named lemma and the composite identifies the sheafy trace map as a bijection on all Hom sets (source lines 4158-4189)
